jobs.name: hero
jobs.prompt: Wide promotional hero banner illustration in the exact style of the reference images: flat vector cartoon, bold clean shapes, soft cel shading, thick dark espresso-brown outlines, warm golden-yellow palette. A sunny shiba inu village on rolling golden and lime-green hills with cozy cottages with orange roofs, round trees, sunflowers, fences and a winding path. On the right third, the cheerful shiba inu doge mascot from the reference (golden amber fur, cream chest, classic side-eye smirk) sits proudly on a grassy hilltop next to a tiny glowing laptop. Glowing golden sync ribbons flow out of the laptop and connect to four small floating rounded game cards hovering in the sky around the dog, each card showing a different tiny cartoon game scene (a colourful obby with jumping platforms, a castle, a race track, a rocket on a launchpad). Little bees and fluffy cream clouds drift around. The whole left 45 percent of the picture is calm open bright warm sky and soft distant hills with nothing important in it, reserved for a headline. Bright, lively, happy, never dark. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
